summary: Rebuilt the permanent accuracy checker on claude/accuracy-baseline (from origin/claude/accuracy a7c9581). No app behaviour changes. Seeded pricing fixture (lib/pricing/__fixtures__/seeded-rows.json + seeded.ts, built by scripts/accuracy/seeded-rows.sh from a fresh migrated database through scripts/accuracy/bundle-rows.sql; lib/accuracy/rows.ts PRICING_SETTING_KEYS, stableRows, diffRows); random quotes (lib/pricing/__fixtures__/random.ts: mulberry32, randomArea, randomQuote, randomQuotes); engine rules (lib/pricing/invariants.ts) and quote rules (lib/quotes/invariants.ts: PRICE_SURFACES with file:line and snippet, priceTexts rendering the signing page and the three emails for real, compareReadings, checkSamePriceText, expectedHeadline, checkValidUntilIsExpiry, linkExpiresAt); scripts/accuracy/violations.ts (npm run accuracy:violations -- <count> <seed>); 42 unit tests in lib/accuracy/invariants.test.ts on hand-made good and bad quotes; golden sets (golden-export.sql + make-live-golden.ts checked against production md5 and counts; make-synthetic.ts -> golden-synthetic.json, 65 estimates; price-golden.ts). Before counts are in docs/accuracy/before/. The live golden set reproduces the record on every rule (items 13, same work 60, step up 18, labels 6, cavity 0, price text 78, valid until 16; 75 of 76 quoted estimates reprice the same, a0c1dbc7 edited after it was sent; 16 of 77 stored quotes print a day-late Valid until; live pricing rows equal the migrations' rows, ids and win model aside). The random run differs from the record's numbers because the generator was rebuilt from its description (the same seed draws different quotes) and because same_price_text now reads 13 surfaces instead of 9; see notesForNextStage. Checked against the money stage's engine in a scratch merge (not pushed): items_add_up, same_work_same_price and options_step_up read 0 on 2,000 quotes; the checker's 42 tests pass there too.

notDone: No ledger entry: this stage changes no value (docs/accuracy/ledger.txt is left to the stages that change values; the money stage already created it, so not touching it avoids an add/add merge conflict).

The record's exact random counts (e.g. items_add_up 3,355) cannot be reproduced: its generator code and draws were lost; the rebuilt generator follows the written design and gives different quotes from the same seed. The seeded bundle hash also differs (56ccd238ee6bea55 vs 1faaa3f78c91069a) because the record's stable-id scheme was lost; the pricing values are the same (a test pins the record's example totals).

The record's synthetic set (62 estimates) was lost; the new one has 65 (the audit's S1-F1..F9 jobs, the record's examples and typical and edge-case jobs), so its counts differ (items 7, same work 35, step up 16, labels 7, cavity 12, price text 64, valid until 3 vs the record's 5, 30, 20, 9, 9, 61, 2).

PDFs are read through the formatter pdf.tsx calls (QuotePdf is not exported, and the PDF stream is compressed), not rendered; the thank-you sentence shown after signing is component state, so it is read through priceExact; everything else on the signing page and every email is rendered.
notesForNextStage: HOW TO RUN: npm run accuracy:violations -- 10000 20261118 (about 70 s); node scripts/accuracy/run.mjs scripts/accuracy/price-golden.ts synthetic <out.json>; ... price-golden.ts live <golden dir> <out.json> [<summary.json>] with the live export in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/e9b02a42-cb4a-5aa1-bf7b-e82e27ad6b23/scratchpad/accuracy/golden/ (live-estimates.json, live-rows.json; md5 9c05cfd7a5952970a13b20441dd9ea65 and 3422ab87fd74a169ff5d84aa1dbde123, checked against production). docs/accuracy/checker.txt says the same. Scripts run through scripts/accuracy/run.mjs (Vite's module runner, '@/' alias), no new tool. MERGING WITH MONEY: merges cleanly except package.json (both stages may touch scripts; mine adds the typecheck second tsc and accuracy:violations). shownOptions(priced) = priced.options minus anything marked hidden, which already matches the money engine (it returns only shown options unless showAll). workItems skip lines with areaId null or kind other than 'work', so travel, minimum and adjustment lines are never 'same work'; finite_amounts lets an 'adjustment' item be negative. After the money merge expect items_add_up, same_work_same_price and options_step_up at 0; labels code_below_code and the cavity rule stay for the insulation fixes; same_price_text keeps accept_sentence, signed_page, signed_pdf, signed_email and office_email (they print cents: L8) and office_list (headline from model_total_price: L9, not done by money); valid_until_is_expiry stays for L13. The money stage's lib/pricing/__fixtures__/migrationSeed.ts can now give way to seeded.ts (seededBundle, bundleFromRows). WHAT CHANGED VERSUS THE RECORD'S CHECKER: same_price_text reads 13 surfaces: the record's 9 plus quote_page (chosen option and total; 0), signed_page (thank-you sentence and signed summary; L8 names it; prints cents, one per option), jobs_list and job_page (signed price, cents when the price has cents; 765 each). office_email reads the subject AND the body; the body prints 'Price: $4,780.00', so it breaks on every option (the record's 0 must have read only the subject; L8 says 'signed emails' plural were fixed). labels_match_work: spray foam keeps an air-sealing promise ('Air seal and insulate in one step'); air_sealing 36 remain where such a bullet comes from an area with no work in a multi-area quote. The cavity rule allows one whole bag of slack (the last bag of a ceil is partly used), takes waste out of the priced quantity, and reads existing insulation at its depth, else R over the app's R-per-inch table (lib/ai/photoRead R_PER_INCH, any case; unknown material at the highest R per inch). Headline (OD1) = lib/field/recommended.ts recommendedTier: the pick if shown, else Better, else the first option. KEEPING IT TRUE: PRICE_SURFACES entries carry a snippet that a test requires to still be in its file; when SignForm, pdf.tsx, email.ts or the office/jobs pages change a price formatter, update the entry and priceTexts. The signing page extraction anchors on 'You are accepting', 'Sign and accept', '<Tier> · Your choice' and 'What the price covers' ... 'Total'; the email ones on the option name, 'Price:' and the subject; a missing anchor reads '(no ...)' and counts as a violation, so wording changes are loud. If the quotes stage changes buildQuoteDocument's validUntil to a full timestamp, checkValidUntilIsExpiry still works (it formats with longDate). After a migration that changes a seeded value, run DATABASE_URL=... bash scripts/accuracy/seeded-rows.sh and commit the JSON; if a stage adds a pricing setting key, add it to PRICING_SETTING_KEYS and bundle-rows.sql (a test checks both lists match). ENVIRONMENT: a symlinked node_modules breaks the Turbopack build in a worktree; I used a hard-linked copy (cp -al ../koala-estimator/node_modules node_modules) for e2e.
